alt: Theme 3, ہجرت ترکِ وطن اور کثیر الثقافتی معاشرہ (Immigration and the multicultural society), has three sub-themes: positive features of a diverse society, attitudes towards immigration, and emigration from Pakistan (پاکستان سے ہجرت), the research subject.
caption: Three sub-themes; emigration from Pakistan is the research subject.

after: ## Sub-theme 3.1: positive features of a diverse society
alt: Diversity (تنوع) at the centre of four positives: cultural variety, economic contribution, learning and understanding, and shared citizenship. Key words: کثیر الثقافتی, رواداری, باہمی احترام, ثقافت, زبان, تہوار, شہریت.
caption: Variety, contribution, understanding and shared citizenship.

alt: Welcoming attitudes see migrants as contributors and neighbours; worries concern jobs, housing, services and local identity. Related issues are prejudice and discrimination (تعصب, امتیازی سلوک), integration and identity (انضمام, شناخت) and the media. Answer by stating each side, its reasons, then your judgement.
caption: Give both sides with their reasons, then say which convinces you and why.

alt: Push factors in Pakistan (limited jobs, lower wages, insecurity, study) and pull factors (higher pay, family links, services) lead to the Gulf region and to Europe and North America. Remittances (ترسیلاتِ زر) flow back; skilled emigration raises brain drain (ذہین افراد کا انخلا) and there are effects on families.
caption: Push, pull, remittances and brain drain: the core of the research subject.

after: ## Worked example: a model paragraph, with annotation
alt: The four moves of the model paragraph on migration: a contribution (لے جاتے ہیں, masculine plural), its result (معاشرہ ... بن جاتا ہے), a counter-view introduced by تاہم with a reason after کیونکہ, and a reasoned conclusion with میرے خیال میں.
caption: Point, result, counter-view with تاہم, then a reasoned conclusion.
